mainEntity.name: What is a granny flat, and how is it used?

acceptedAnswer.text: A granny flat is a self-contained living area on the same property as a single-family home, designed for independent living with its own sleeping, kitchen, and bathroom facilities. Homeowners often build them for aging parents, adult children, or extended family members. Depending on your property, a granny flat can be constructed as a detached cottage, an attached home addition, or an interior conversion such as a transformed garage. During an initial consultation, builders review your property layout to see whether an attached room expansion or a standalone build works best for your household goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: A granny flat is a self-contained living space on a residential lot, featuring a private bathroom, bedroom, and kitchen area, commonly built for aging parents or extended family.
